top_signals.title: ‘Disaster’: Advisers raise the alarm on family business tax raid
top_signals.summary: John Healey’s potential tax raid on family businesses could make handing down companies to the next generation a “disaster” and damage the economy, advisers have warned. The Chancellor is reportedly considering proposals to levy income tax when business owners hand down to their children, potentially almost doubling the bill. top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
